details:
safety shield by distance for each mode and rank.

this should work with every togglable option in shield settings.

just like earmuff mode and avatar culling.

the animations and effects should only touch the player who is causing the effects to happen, if they want to be inside the bubble therefore the effect should have a limited range of 1 meter by default when this option is turned on.

lets say I am surrounded by a bubble. and my friend who is on the outside of that bubble cannot see any animations, particles, and so forth outside that bubble. But the inside looks crazy like effects are going on inside it but my friend can still see the avatar im using without being harmed.

Anytime that effect touches the bubble it would practically remove that effect by default on the inside rendering it on the outside to be completely useless.

this would be a fine addition to use with personal space.

how would it completely screw over crashers in 2024 you may ask:

let's say an invisible 1 meter bubble surrounds the players, someone brings out a crasher and tries to crash multiple players, using a particle or a bunch of nukes, it would completely make the particle and nukes disappear before going past the barrier, rendering the crasher useless.

now loppy what about big, huge, insta crashers that crash the lobby:

this would be able to prevent it from even happening because it wouldn't effect the player and practically you cant even close a instance using a crasher anyways. its not possible.

and because it would be locally applied the barrier wouldn't disappear even if they changed there avatar. like avatar culling but you can see the avatar and can't be affected by it.

now for the dev team, when the code from the shader, particle, collider or so forth that is sent to the barrier from the inside, the code being sent outside would be barred from leaving the barrier and would completely cut off the code from ever trying to bypass the barrier. meaning if someone were to try sending a malicious code into vrchat it would not be able to execute outside the barrier, keeping other players safe from those that have safety by distance barrier applied to them. 

its basically like a bubble that surrounds the player or players that prevents them from sending stuff outside to harm others. i know its possible because back in 2016 i saw a admin using a bright blue orb around themselves to protect themselves from being clicked on. this was in the room of the rain and they were using a mini bird type avatar. 

i feel like doing the reverse is possible with this idea.

simply put if you can hide a avatar and they turn into a hovering robot then why cant you implement this? not saying its not possible but the code should look like your implementing a firewall i guess you could say.

so basically, instead of a robot it would show that avatar but it would disable anything that tries to bypass the bubbled safety system and i do mean anything though if this were implemented it would need adjusting still because not everything is perfect but this would be the first step to be able to see avatars without crashing at all from this. because all players would have to do is keep on personal space while the 1 meter is enabled and wellah can't crash if you cannot see there avatar when they get close to you.

its basically like setting a firewall up for vrchat but only for avatar effects, while still seeing the avatar. but then again the amount of code wont affect the gameplay much because the code would be cut off from the barrier rendering the code being executed less equivalent, then being sent forward.

and yes this would also help quest users from crashing as well.

please let me know if i missed anything i should add to this
title: avatar shield bubble instead of using a annoying hovering robot.
